Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 2, the Planner incorrectly identified Princess Margaretha of Saxony's mother as "Archduchess Luise of Austria-Tuscany". The first search result (from the WebSurfer in Step 1) clearly stated that Margaretha was the daughter of "King John of Saxony and his wife Princess Amalie Auguste of Bavaria". The Planner ignored this explicit information and hallucinated a completely different mother (Luise), leading to all subsequent steps searching for the birthplace of the wrong person.
